_comment: Compact DeepWiki routing hints for contributors. Scope: repo_notes and page outlines only; canonical docs and code remain authoritative. The furnace, cron jobs, tests, and playback clients do not read this file.

repo_notes.content: JellyFlam3 Server is a self-hosted generative media pipeline: flam3 renders flame-fractal genomes to H.264 MP4 loops, catalogs them in Jellyfin under /media/sheep/by-generation/, and streams to Roku (VoD + stills screensaver) and Kodi (video screensaver). The Raspberry Pi is the furnace (render factory); TVs/clients are the pasture (playback only).
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content:
CANONICAL DOCS — use these before inferring architecture from code or these hints:
- Architecture SoT: docs/Pi5_Flam3_VoD_Pipeline.md
- Guide index + phase status: docs/README.md
- Layered user/operator/contributor guide: docs/USER_GUIDE_AND_RUNBOOK.md
- Vocabulary: docs/glossary.md
- Per-phase overviews: docs/phase1|phase2|phase3|phase4|phase5/00_OVERVIEW.md
This file is compact routing metadata for generated pages, not a second source of truth. Prefer links to canonical guides over reproducing long procedures.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: PHASE STATUS (2026-10-18): Phase 1 complete (Owner OK 2026-07-28). Phase 2 complete (Owner OK 2026-08-08). Phase 3 complete (Owner OK 2026-08-23). Public launch v0.3.0/v0.3.1; Phase 4 implemented in v0.3.2 (2026-09-23): tuples, votes, naming, rotate, mesh introduce, worker drain, FIFO inbox, wrap-once 313. JellyFlam3 VoD is published on the Roku Channel Store. Leftovers: JellyFlam3 Dreams Store listing; optional Jellyfin OriginalTitle/SortName. Current source manifests: VoD 1.0.55, Roku SS 1.0.11, Kodi 0.2.15. Phase 5 LLM work is parked and split between the Pi furnace and a separate Ventuno Q agent platform. Fleet tracks master.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content:
REPO LAYOUT PRIORITIES for documentation:
- pipeline/ — worker, FIFO/drain, archive seed, breed/tuple, Shears/Hammer/refactor, votes/naming/reporting, peering, idle gate, disk/capacity
- scripts/ — health, cron wrappers, smoke, packaging, jellyfin_id_dump, client presets

repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: FLEET HOSTS (operator reference): Furnace Pis rpi-jellyflam3-{16,08,04}a at their LAN IPs; install path /opt/jellyflam3-server; user jellyflam3. Kodi pasture host (e.g. rpi-kodi-08a) on LibreELEC — no worker. Roku clients on the LAN. Jellyfin on furnace LAN IP :8096 — clients must use LAN IP, never 127.0.0.1.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: JELLYFIN FLOCK QUERY QUIRK (critical): Jellyfin 10.x ParentId=Sheep library + Recursive Movie/Video often returns a PARTIAL flock (e.g. 1 of 6) when MP4s live under by-generation/{gen}/ child folders. All clients (Roku VoD JellyfinTask.brs, Roku SS StillsTask.brs, Kodi jellyfin_flock.py, scripts/jellyfin_id_dump.py) MUST walk child Folder items and merge/dedupe — empty-only fallback is insufficient. Sideload Roku 1.0.28 / 1.0.7 and Kodi 0.2.6+.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: JELLYFIN IMAGES (Primary/Backdrop): live catalog posters and screensaver frames live under stills/{stem}/ with stills/.ignore — Jellyfin does not attach local Primary/Backdrop from those JPEGs. Clients need ImageTags.Primary / BackdropImageTags from POST /Items/{id}/Images/{type}. Jellyfin 10.9+ ImageController wraps the POST body in FromBase64Transform; pipeline.encode_image_upload_body base64-encodes JPEG/PNG. Raw image bytes 500 FormatException. Sidecar local_primary and disk-only stills are not complete; backfill_posters re-uploads.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: SECRETS AND CONFIG: Never document or commit secrets.env, filled jellyflam3.yaml, or API keys. Reference secrets.env / JELLYFIN_API_KEY only. Sheep library ParentId must point at Sheep virtual folder (path /media/sheep/by-generation), NOT /media/sheep mount root. Keep Rework Poster library separate (/media/sheep/_refactor-preview).
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: ROKU CONSTRAINTS: Developer mode allows ONE sideloaded package per device — VoD channel and screensaver alternate; registry JellyFlam3 keys survive zip swap. Furnace-built zips embed registry/jellyflam3-presets.json via scripts/client_pack_presets.py. Commercial filtering is client-side (isCommercialSafe); never pass Tags= to Jellyfin Items API (AND semantics empty flock). VoD 1.0.30 always persists shuffleFlock=true on launch (package presets must not copy this key; leftover false from empty Settings save / older force-sync survives sideload otherwise). VoD 1.0.31 / Roku SS 1.0.9 wrap-refetch Jellyfin after a full shuffle permutation (Limit 5000, prune to 313; rotate past last-played). Roku screensaver ignores shuffleFlock and always rotates stills.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: ARCHIVE FEED + FIFO: configs/archive_seed_manifest.json is a tracked random-pick pool of generation/sheep ids only; no genome XML or license. --archive and cron_archive_seed.sh read it. --sheep and --from-file fetch named ids without reading it. --refresh-manifest scrapes the configured best pages and keeps _comment. Download fallback is named .flam3, genome.html /spex, then sheepserver. Every staging path stamps pipeline.inbox_queue; the worker claims oldest arrival, not lexical filename. Default --skip-catalog avoids re-rendering catalog hits.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: LICENSE BOUNDARIES: infer_tags_from_genome treats a non-brood nick as human/cc-by and unknown or brood as cc-by-nc. license.commercial_mode does NOT restrict archive downloads or worker ingest; it changes tuple watermark policy and makes share_votes skip NC. Roku commercialMode and Kodi commercial_mode are separate client-side filters. The proposed seed_archive both/commercial/noncommercial selector is documented as a future improvement, not shipped.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: IDLE GATE: jellyflam3-idlegate pauses worker when Jellyfin reports active TV playback (Roku Client=JellyFlam3). Roku Screensaver and Kodi screensaver use Client=JellyFlam3-Screensaver so gate stays open during stills/video screensaver. healthcheck.sh and bringup_check.sh fail closed on bad units, missing gate status, Opt In without live Syncthing+Tailscale. WORKER DRAIN (distinct): python3 -m pipeline.worker_drain request finishes the current inbox job then stops claiming until cancel; flag persists across restart; healthcheck WARNs while drained.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: DEFERRED / OUT OF SCOPE (do not document as shipped): continuous live HLS from shuffled MP4s; Gold Sheep / paid ES masters; DeepDream and full social flock; Phase 5 LLM pedigree/naming on the separate Ventuno platform; Kodi standalone edge sequencer (tuples are one MP4); JellyFlam3 Dreams Store listing; Jellyfin OriginalTitle/SortName-as-alias; archive commercial/noncommercial download selector; automatic peer promote. VoD Store publication is shipped. HLS remains an opt-in analysis mode with known stale-segment behavior; ambient default is Static MP4.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: TESTING (2026-10-18): python3 -m pytest tests/ -q; 610 tests currently collect. Fleet uses apt python3-pytest. smoke_render.sh, hls_smoke.sh, and fleet smoke scripts require lab hardware and are not ordinary pytest. CI: .github/workflows/tests.yml plus release.yml on tag push; ensure_exec_bits.sh --check runs in CI. Treat the test count as a dated snapshot.
repo_notes.author: Owner

page_notes.content: Include 2026-08-23 confirmation: flat ParentId returned partial flock; folder walk returns full flock; client merge required. Roku VoD + screensaver verified after sideload 1.0.26/1.0.6.

stills/.ignore: catalog JPEGs are not Jellyfin Primaries or Backdrops. VoD FlockItem shows No poster without ImageTags.Primary. Roku SS mixes Primaries only until BackdropImageTags exist. Images POST must be base64 on Jellyfin 10.11.

Concerns: Jellyfin API behavior may change; child-folder walk is capped at 50 direct folders; no server proxy; Store VoD has empty Settings while furnace sideloads may preset secrets; Roku developer mode has one sideload slot; registry secrets remain device-local.
